sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW AND ASSOCIATED TROUGH WILL MOVE SEWD ACROSS THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST AND INTERMOUNTAIN WEST AS A 60 TO 75 KT MID-LEVEL JET ROUNDS THE BASE OF THE TROUGH. THE EXIT REGION OF THE JET WILL OVERSPREAD A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES AND NRN HIGH PLAINS WITH SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING THIS AFTERNOON FROM CNTRL/ERN MT SEWD ACROSS NRN/ERN WY INTO SWRN SD AND WRN NEB. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO ORGANIZE ON THE NRN END OF THIS CORRIDOR. ON THE SRN END IN WRN NEB...STORM COVERAGE IS MORE UNCERTAIN DUE TO MODEL VARIANCE AND WARM AIR ALOFT WHICH COULD KEEP CONVECTION RELATIVELY ISOLATED. CONCERNING THE SEVERE THREAT...THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID-LEVEL JET WILL CREATE MODERATE TO STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES ACROSS THE WRN EDGE OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA WHICH ALONG WITH VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS SHOULD BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE TORNADOES FROM SE MT SEWD INTO WRN SD WHERE THE HIGHEST PROBABILITY OF SCATTERED STORM COVERAGE COINCIDES WITH A STRONG INSTABILITY/SHEAR COMBINATION. MCS DEVELOPMENT APPEARS MOST LIKELY A

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS/MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: A WELL-FOCUSED UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE GREAT LAKES REGION WILL MOVE EWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS TODAY. AT THE SFC...A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY WITH STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG THE FRONT AND MOVING INTO SRN NY AND CNTRL PA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ETA-KF FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THE MOIST AXIS IN CNTRL PA AT 00Z SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR VALUES AROUND 40 KT ALONG WITH STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW-LEVELS SUGGESTING A SUPERCELL AND ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT MAY DEVELOP. LARGE HAIL WOULD BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY SUPERCELLS. HOWEVER...THE DOMINANT STORM MODE REMAINS UNCERTAIN AND A BOWING LINE-SEGMENT WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE AS THE FRONT MOVES QUICKLY EWD. IF A LINEAR MCS CAN DEVELOP...THEN AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT COULD OCCUR ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL AND ERN PA SWD INTO NRN MD.

sections.title: CAROLINAS AND ERN GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: A VERY MOIST AIRMASS WILL AGAIN BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE CAROLINAS EXTENDING SWWD INTO GA AND ERN AL THIS AFTERNOON. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F SHOULD YIELD STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE. SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIATE IN A WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT BY EARLY TO MID-AFTERNOON WHEN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE VERY STEEP. THIS COMBINATION OF PARAMETERS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE PULSE STORMS WITH WET DOWNBURSTS POTENTIAL. THE THREAT APPEARS TO BE GREAT ENOUGH TO WARRANT A SLIGHT RISK FROM NC SSWWD INTO SRN/CNTRL GA...SE AL AND THE NRN FL PANHANDLE. ..BROYLES/GARNER.. 06/16/2010

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES INTO MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: MIDLEVEL TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER THE UPPER GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY WILL TRANSLATE EWD WITH INCREASED FORCING FOR ASCENT AND A BELT OF 40-50 KT FLOW OVERSPREADING THE REGION FROM THE WEST LATER TODAY. AT THE SAME TIME...ATTENDING SURFACE LOW WILL DEVELOP ACROSS SWRN ONTARIO...EVENTUALLY INTO NWRN NEW ENGLAND LATE TONIGHT...WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT PROVIDES THE FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. IN THE WAKE OF AN ELEVATED BAND OF TSTMS CURRENTLY PROGRESSING EWD THROUGH UPSTATE NY AND CNTRL PA...DAYTIME HEATING AND A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER ARE EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO DESTABILIZATION OF WARM SECTOR AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE RANGING FROM 500-1000 J/KG OVER PARTS OF NY TO 1000-2500 J/KG FROM S-CNTRL PA INTO CNTRL VA. THE COMBINATION OF DCVA IN ADVANCE OF MIDLEVEL TROUGH AND SUSTAINED CONVERGENCE ALONG COLD FRONT AND LEE/PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH SHOULD YIELD SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS BY AFTERNOON. LARGELY NORMAL ORIENTATION OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR VECTOR TO INITIATING BOUNDARY SUGGESTS THAT INITIAL STORM MODE MAY BE SUPERCELLULAR. MOREOVER...FORECAST HODOGRAPHS INDICATE 0-1 KM SRH OF 100-200 M2/S2 FROM CNTRL/ERN NY SWD INTO NRN VA...SUGGESTING SOME THREAT FOR TORNA

sections.title: SRN VA TO ALONG THE SERN ATLANTIC COASTAL PLAINS
sections.text: WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL TEND TO DECREASE WITH SWD EXTENT ACROSS THE REGION...THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LIKELY SUPPORT A MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS LATER TODAY WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY AS TO HOW FAR SWD THIS STRONGER INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP TODAY DUE TO ONGOING STORMS OVER CNTRL/ERN NC AND MORE WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS THAT MAY PERSIST IN CONJUNCTION WITH MCV OVER SC. BRIEFLY SEVERE PULSE STORMS WILL ONCE AGAIN BE POSSIBLE TODAY IN AREAS WHERE THE STRONGER INSTABILITY CAN DEVELOP WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: NRN INTER-MOUNTAIN REGION INTO THE DAKOTAS AND NEB
sections.text: AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NW INTO NRN CA WILL ASSUME A NEGATIVE TILT LATER IN THE PERIOD IN RESPONSE TO THE EWD PROGRESSION OF MID AND HIGH-LEVEL JET STREAKS THROUGH THE GREAT BASIN INTO CNTRL ROCKIES. AS THIS OCCURS...BROAD SURFACE LOW PRESSURE WILL CONSOLIDATE INTO A DEEPENING LEE CYCLONE OVER SERN MT/NERN WY. INITIAL STRONG TO SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ALONG PACIFIC FRONT PROGRESSING EWD THROUGH WRN MT/ERN ID/NRN UT/WRN WY WITHIN A ZONE OF STRONG...DYNAMIC FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH MIDLEVEL TROUGH. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STEEP LAPSE RATE PROFILES WITH SBCAPE APPROACHING 500-1000 J/KG. STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR...A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND RELATIVELY COOL THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND SEVERE HAIL WITH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING FROM VICINITY OF THE DEEPENING SURFACE LOW SWD ALONG THE LEE TROUGH/DRY LINE FROM S-CNTRL/SERN MT THROUGH ERN WY/WRN SD INTO WRN NEB. HERE...A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH SWD EXTENT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE OF 1500-3500 J/KG. STRONGER CAPPING AND T

sections.title: ERN CO/KS SWD INTO THE SRN PLAINS
sections.text: AN MCS HAS PERSISTED OVERNIGHT ACROSS THE OK/TX PNHDLS WITH ADDITIONAL MORE ISOLATED STORMS NOTED OVER WRN KS AND N-CNTRL OK. INSPECTION OF WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK MIDLEVEL PERTURBATION MOVING THROUGH NM AND SRN CO...COUPLED WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA ARE LIKELY MECHANISMS CONTRIBUTING TO THIS STORM ACTIVITY. LATEST MESOSCALE AND HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL DATA INDICATE THAT THIS ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST TODAY WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS FORMING ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/ERN KS. WHILE MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WERE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP...12Z OUN/TOP SOUNDINGS SHOW THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH LOWEST 100 MB MEAN MIXING RATIOS OF 15-16 G/KG. WHEN COUPLED WITH DAYTIME HEATING AND STEEPENING MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES FROM THE W...ENVIRONMENT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN ON THE MARGINS OF THAT WHICH SUPPORTS SUSTAINED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS. HOWEVER...THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SUGGESTS A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE MORE INTENSE STORMS. sections.title: NY/PA/MID ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: SATELLITE LOOPS SHOW A BROAD UPPER TROUGH OVER THE WESTERN STATES...AND A LARGE RIDGE OVER THE SOUTHEAST. A LOWER AMPLITUDE TROUGH IS MOVING ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES REGION WHICH WILL PROVIDE THE FOCUS FOR AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER NY/PA AND PARTS OF THE MID ATLANTIC REGION. CLOUDS HAVE PERSISTED IN THIS AREA...LIMITING HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION. NEVERTHELESS...SCATTERED CONVECTION WILL LIKELY FORM BY MID AFTERNOON ALONG/AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING COLD FRONT OVER WESTERN/CENTRAL PA AND CENTRAL NY. DEEP LAYER WIND FIELDS WILL PROMOTE CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND THE THREAT OF A FEW SUPERCELLS. DAMAGING WINDS APPEAR TO BE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR LARGE HAIL REPORT CANNOT BE RULED OUT. STORMS WILL SPREAD EASTWARD THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING TOWARD THE COAST BEFORE WEAKENING.

sections.title: EASTERN KS/OK
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS PERSISTED OVERNIGHT AND SPREAD INTO NORTHERN OK/SOUTHERN KS. THESE STORMS ARE MOVING INTO A VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS AND ARE LIKELY TO REMAIN RATHER INTENSE THROUGH THE DAY AS THEY TRACK SLOWLY EASTWARD. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW RATHER STEEP LOW AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...DESPITE WEAK WIND FIELDS. WEAKLY ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORM STRUCTURES ARE EXPECTED WITH A RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: ID/MT/WY
sections.text: A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER ORE/NV IS FORECAST TO ROTATE SHARPLY NORTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF ID/UT/WY/MT THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. STRONG WINDS ALOFT AND FORCING FOR UPWARD MOTION WILL OVERSPREAD THIS REGION...HELPING TO FOCUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE COLD FRONT FROM NORTHERN UT INTO CENTRAL MT. STRONG HEATING ALONG MUCH OF THIS CORRIDOR WILL LEAD TO STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES PROMOTING THE RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS IN STRONGER CELLS. STORMS WILL SPREAD EASTWARD INTO WESTERN WY DURING THE EVENING BEFORE WEAKENING.

sections.title: NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL INTENSIFY THIS EVENING ALONG THE LEE TROF FROM WESTERN NEB NORTHWARD INTO EASTERN MT. STRONG AND INCREASING EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES SUGGEST SUPERCELLS WILL BE THE DOMINANT STORM MODE WITH A RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. THIS ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST MUCH OF THE NIGHT OVER THE DAKOTAS ON NOSE OF 60 KNOT SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET.

sections.title: EASTERN NC
sections.text: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A WEAK REMNANT MVC OVER THE CAROLINAS. THE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE FEATURE HAS BECOME VERY WARM/UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 3000+ J/KG. THIS REGION WILL LIKELY SEE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS IN THE STRONGER STORMS.

sections.title: SOUTHERN AL/GA AND THE FL PENINSULA
sections.text: STRONG HEATING AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE RESULTING IN RAPID DESTABILIZATION FROM SOUTHERN AL/GA INTO MUCH OF THE FL PENINSULA TODAY. THIS SUGGESTS THE RISK OF ISOLATED DISORGANIZED BUT INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF WET MICROBURSTS. ..HART/GRAMS.. 06/16/2010

sections.title: NY/PA/NW NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: LEAD PORTION OF STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED UVV IS NOW PASSING ERN LK ONTARIO. ANOTHER PART OF THE TROUGH REMAINS UPSTREAM OVER/N OF LK ERIE /PER WV IMAGERY/. SFC COLD FRONT ATTM ARCS FROM NEAR KART S AND THEN SW ACROSS N CNTRL PA INTO ERN WV. CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT...IN CONJUNCTION WITH LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND MODEST SFC HEATING...MAY YET SUPPORT SCTD TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM UPSTATE NY SW INTO CNTRL PA...DESPITE WEAK LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES. MORE ISOLD ACTIVITY MAY INTENSIFY IN AXIS OF GREATER INSTABILITY BUT WEAKER FORCING SSW INTO WRN MD/VA. 40-45 KT DEEP WSWLY SHEAR AND MOISTENING/SLIGHTLY BACKED LOW LVL FLOW JUST AHEAD OF FRONT SUGGEST A CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS AND ISOLD TORNADOES WITH ANY SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS THAT DO FORM. THE THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH AFTER SUNSET.

sections.title: SRN HI PLNS
sections.text: EXTENDED LOW PROBABILISTIC SLIGHT RISK OVER THE CNTRL HI PLNS SWD INTO ERN NM...WHERE WV IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT A SRN STREAM IMPULSE MAY BE AIDING STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE ERN NM MOUNTAINS. GIVEN SUPPORTIVE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS AND/OR SVR HAIL WITH STRONGER STORMS THROUGH SUNSET.

sections.title: NE UT/WRN WY INTO MT
sections.text: MODERATE TO STRONG...UNIDIRECTIONAL SSWLY FLOW ATOP INCREASINGLY DEEPLY-MIXED ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT ORGANIZATION OF ON-GOING STORMS IN NE UT/WRN WY AND S CNTRL MT INTO BANDS. EMBEDDED SMALL SCALE BOWING SEGMENTS MAY POSE A THREAT FOR STRONG/POSSIBLY SVR WIND GUSTS THROUGH MID EVE. ..CORFIDI.. 06/16/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT WED JUN 16 2010/

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: A VIGOROUS SHORT WAVE TROUGH IS NOW IN THE PROCESS OF LIFTING NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF THE GREAT BASIN. AS THIS CONTINUES THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS...A DEEPENING SURFACE CYCLONE IS PROGGED TO MIGRATE NORTHWARD TO THE LEE OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES...ACROSS EASTERN MONTANA. AS THIS OCCURS...A SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE STRENGTHENING THROUGH MUCH OF THE PLAINS...WHILE VERY WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR ADVECTS NORTH NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH MUCH OF THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS. DUE TO STRENGTHENING INHIBITION...CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL INTO AND THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT HOURS REMAINS A BIT UNCERTAIN...BUT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION WILL CONTINUE. IN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES...THIS WILL MAINTAIN MODERATE TO STRONG CAPE ACROSS MUCH OF THE DAKOTAS INTO EASTERN MONTANA. BEFORE INHIBITION STRENGTHENS FURTHER...FOCUSED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE BENEATH INCREASINGLY DIFLUENT AND DIVERGENT UPPER FLOW STILL MAY STILL SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONGOING CONVECTION INTO A SEVERE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM ACROSS WESTERN NORTH DAKOTA AND ADJACENT EASTERN MONTANA/NORTHWESTERN SOUTH DAKOTA. STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING...WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE...IN ADDITION TO THE RISK FOR LARGE H

sections.title: SOUTH CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE REGION REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE. DESPITE STRENGTHENING INHIBITION...SHEAR ASSOCIATED WITH A STRENGTHENING SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET MAY MAINTAIN THE VIGOR OF THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER NOW ADVANCING NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE TEXAS/OKLAHOMA PANHANDLE REGION...AT LEAST THROUGH LATE EVENING. SOME HAIL IS POSSIBLE...BUT THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS PROBABLY IS MORE PROMINENT.

sections.title: OZARKS INTO THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY
sections.text: ONGOING STORMS APPEAR TO BE GENERALLY WEAKENING...BUT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR OVERNIGHT...AS LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION REMAINS FOCUSED ACROSS THE REGION. AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL IN STRONGER STORMS. ..KERR.. 06/17/2010
